Product CatalogueChildren’s Educational Toys

A curated range of 42 educational toys sourced from a Chinese cross-border shopping platform for import into Malaysia. Unit prices are shown in Malaysian Ringgit, with the supplier’s yuan price in brackets. Delivery totals include SST and any shipping fee.

Delivery terms (the same for every product unless a note says otherwise)

By sea

Free shipping, plus SST. Arrives in 10–12 business days. The sea total is the checkout order total (unit price + SST + shipping).

By air

A weight-based shipping fee of about RM 4.97 (¥8), plus SST. Arrives in 5–8 business days. The air total is the checkout order total (unit price + SST + shipping).

Where a checkout screenshot was not supplied, the total is shown as Not provided. SST figures are the checkout estimates. Packages are consolidated at the warehouse after purchase.

Confidential — for business planning use. Prices and delivery estimates are as shown on the supplier’s checkout screens on the date of compilation.
